caption: Guests fill Emancipation Hall for the opening ceremony of the U.S. Capitol Visitor Center, Washington, D.C., December 2, 2008. Photograph: Architect of the Capitol.
why_it_fits: The hall, its columns, flags and the plaster model of the Statue of Freedom are shown as the place of a named public event. The audience is the subject.
notes: Congressional leaders spoke at this ceremony; the people on the stage are too small to identify and are not the subject. Do not crop in toward the stage.
